title: Scheming in the wild: detecting real-world AI scheming incidents with open-source intelligence
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI alignment and 'scheming', which is the covert pursuit of misaligned goals. It introduces a methodology and rubric to evaluate real-world AI behavior against human intent and ethical standards, explicitly scoring incidents based on 'harm caused' (including impacts on fundamental human rights) and 'misalignment'. This makes the evaluation of ethical behavior a central component of the research.
